name: The Olive of the Facultad de Medicina

location.address: Campus Universidad de Zaragoza, behind the Facultad de Medicina

access: Free, on the public university campus
transport: Campus San Francisco; tram or bus to Plaza San Francisco, short walk
verify_notes: A short, wide olive, 4.90m round at the base against 2.50m at 1.30m height and only 5m tall, condition rated 'muy bueno' (very good) in 2005. Stands on the University of Zaragoza campus behind the Facultad de Medicina and Colegio Mayor Pedro Cerbuna, owned by the university per the city ordinance's Anejo III. Single-sourced to the city's own catalogue, flagged accordingly.

name: The Honey Locust of Calle Aznar Molina
transport: Casco Historico, near Parque Bruil; a short walk from the already-published Parque Bruil trees
verify_notes: A honey locust pruned of three main branches into a flat parasol shape, genuinely unusual to look at, condition 'bueno' (good) in 2005. Stands 300m from the already-published Huerva poplar walk, in the Tenerias quarter near Parque Bruil. Single-sourced to the city's own catalogue, flagged accordingly.

name: The Tree of Heaven of the Parque Grande Botanical Garden

location.address: Jardin Botanico, Parque Grande Jose Antonio Labordeta, Zaragoza

transport: Parque Grande; tram to Parque Grande stop, short walk to the botanical garden entrance
verify_notes: The best-conditioned of four registered tree of heaven specimens in the city ('muy bueno', 2004), 2.57m round and 15.70m tall, at the entrance to the botanical garden inside Parque Grande. Anchors a second Zaragoza cluster around Parque Grande. Single-sourced to the city's own catalogue, flagged accordingly.
